newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Dragon Oil sets 3-for-5 rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Dragon Oil sets 3-for-5 rights issue.

text.p: Irish oil exploration and production group Dragon Oil Plc said on Friday it planned to offer up to 3.24 billion new ordinary shares at 2.0 (British) pence.

Dragon Oil said the three-for-five rights issue was expected to raise around 62.5 million stg net of expenses and help fund offshore drilling in Turkmenistan and an appraisal programme for a gas discovery in Thailand.

Dragon Oil said its two largest shareholders Satellite Overseas Limited (SOL) and Sinophil Corporation had agreed to take up their entire entitlements of 1.5 billion and 603 million new ordinary shares respectively. representing 46.8 percent and 18.6 percent of Dragon's issued capital.
Dragon said there were difficulties in operating in Turkmenistan but it believed sufficient progress has been made to warrant more investment.
